events.title: Transistor invented at Bell Labs
events.summary: The transistor replaced fragile vacuum tubes and made modern electronics possible.

narrative.whyChosen: It is the physical layer beneath nearly every digital device that came after it.
narrative.whyImportant: Transistors enabled miniaturization, lower power use, and mass production of reliable circuits.
narrative.problemSolved: Vacuum tubes were large, hot, fragile, and expensive. Computing and telecom needed something smaller and more dependable.
